data.name: Meta_Title
data.value: Ezgi Craft - Natural Wood Designs & Art Pieces

data.name: Meta_Description
data.value: Ezgi Craft — natural wood furniture, handmade décor and boutique craft pieces. Discover timeless designs, carefully made in our workshop.

data.name: Hero_Subtitle
data.value: We bring the warmth of natural wood, the precision of handcraft and a minimalist aesthetic into your home. Every piece shaped in our workshop is a timeless work of art.

data.name: About_Title
data.value: Where Design, Material and Craft Meet

data.name: About_P1
data.value: At Ezgi Craft, we bring nature, aesthetics and handwork into your living spaces. We create more than furniture: original wood designs, artistic décor and handmade craft pieces that make a home feel complete. Durable woods, carefully chosen in our workshop, are given new life by skilled hands.

data.name: About_P2
data.value: Like nature itself, every piece we make is unique. Far from mass production, our boutique designs are shaped over hours of attention to detail — so your home feels warm, honest and inviting.

data.name: Feature1_Desc
data.value: We work with durable woods such as beech, walnut, olive and maple, sourced from sustainable forests with a strong natural grain.

data.name: Feature2_Desc
data.value: Every surface is free of splinters and roughness, protected with natural oils that are safe for children and everyday living.

data.name: Feature3_Desc
data.value: After precise workshop cuts, each wood piece is sanded by hand, smoothed and prepared for assembly with care.

data.name: Feature4_Desc
data.value: We design functional pieces, stripped of excess, that bring calm, comfort and quiet elegance to your living spaces.

data.name: Values_Desc
data.value: Our focus in production is natural materials you can trust in your home, flawless handcraft and designs that last.

data.name: Value1_Desc
data.value: Fully organic, long-lasting designs that keep the warmth and unique grain of the wood.

data.name: Value2_Desc
data.value: Rounded soft edges, smooth surfaces and natural finishes with no harsh chemicals.

data.name: Value3_Desc
data.value: Design, precise cutting, hand sanding and protective oiling are all done with workshop care.

data.name: Materials_Desc
data.value: We use only durable, sustainable woods with a strong natural texture.

data.name: Material1_Desc
data.value: A luxurious wood with rich grain and deep tones, chosen for dining tables and special pieces.

data.name: Material2_Desc
data.value: A durable wood with a light tone and smooth surface, giving coffee tables and TV units a modern, open look.

data.name: Material3_Desc
data.value: Slabs with natural edges and living texture, carefully worked in the workshop so every piece is one of a kind.

data.name: Material4_Desc
data.value: Long-lasting, functional designs where industrial metal legs meet a solid wood top.

data.name: Gallery_Desc
data.value: A selection of original wood craft and décor, inspired by nature and made by hand.
